provisional.why: The owner asked for this topic to be built before its reference: "reference which we will do later once youre done". So the numbers in `film` and `sound` are NOT measured from anything. They are a first setting, chosen so that the lint has something to hold a film to.
provisional.from: The camera is the framework's own Zack D grammar (docs/CAMERA-BIBLE.md: one world, a camera that never teleports). The voice, the captions and the sound are the story pipeline's (docs/STORY-FILMS.md). The subjects the owner named: money lessons, and what inflation is.
provisional.whenTheReferenceArrives: Put it in Topics/Explainer/reference/<name>/, measure it (length, words, words a minute, seconds per stop, hard cuts, sound), and replace every number below that it disagrees with. Then delete this block and set `state` to "MEASURED".

camera.note: Scenes are built with flightScene(): one stop for each line, flown to. film.tsx calls unbroken(), which throws if the camera teleports. A film may declare at most `maxHardCuts` shots with `cut: true`.
